focus.jbig: Oil tops $107 · AI leaders urge a slowdown · tech sells off · FOMC Wednesday
focus.jtag: Brent surges past $107 after Saudi shuts a Hormuz-bypass pipeline and AI executives call for pacing the frontier, sinking chip stocks; futures fall two days before the Fed
focus.jnote: The tape opens the week defensive on a double catalyst. Brent crude jumped ~3% toward $107–108 — a four-month high — after Saudi Arabia shut its East-West pipeline (the ~7M bbl/day route that bypasses the Strait of Hormuz) following drone attacks, while GCC–Iran talks were postponed by Tehran; WTI traded above $102–103. Separately, prominent AI executives — Anthropic’s Amodei, OpenAI’s Altman and Elon Musk — publicly called for slowing frontier AI development, and selling spread across the AI/semiconductor complex, pulling Nasdaq futures down over 1%. The 10-year yield sits near a multi-year high (~4.96%) and markets price an ~86–90% chance of a 25bp Fed hike Wednesday. An oil shock stacked on an AI rout two days before the FOMC is not a premium-selling setup.
focus.notdown: Energy (XLE, XOM, MPC, OXY) and Defense (LMT, RTX, NOC) keep a structural war/oil-premium bid, and today they’re the clearest up-group as crude spikes. But be honest: these are two-sided war trades, not clean Snipers — one Hormuz de-escalation or ceasefire headline (Gulf–Iran talks are still on the table) gaps energy straight back down. Watch-only, not table-pounders.
focus.notup: Semiconductors & AI names (NVDA, AMD, and the broad chip complex) are the pressured group after the AI-slowdown call. But selling bear calls into a VIX that can pop and an FOMC two days out carries violent-squeeze risk on any dovish surprise or de-escalation headline — the disciplined answer is to sell nothing new today.
focus.why: Why RED? Composite 63 is squarely WARM and P(≥1% gap) at 46% is well above the 35% trigger — either one alone locks out GREEN. More important: the FOMC (9/16) lands inside a normal DTE with an ~86–90% hike priced, and an unscheduled oil supply shock plus an AI-complex rout make the overnight tail wider and skewed down. The one boarded name (ZIM) is flagged illiquid / OI-thin / liquidity-unverified. Stand down on new credit spreads, or if you must be positioned, use short DTE that clears the FOMC and cut size hard. Cash is a position today.

risks: FOMC · Wed 9/16 — a live hike-or-hold decision with markets pricing an ~86–90% chance of a 25bp move after hot core CPI and surging oil. Any spread must expire before this. The single biggest scheduled event of the week.

Oil & the Strait of Hormuz — Saudi Arabia shut its East-West pipeline (~7M bbl/day Hormuz bypass) after drone attacks and GCC–Iran talks were postponed; Brent topped $107. Any further disruption sends crude (and inflation fear) vertical — the week’s biggest tail.
AI-slowdown headlines — Amodei, Altman and Musk publicly urged pacing frontier AI, sinking the chip/AI complex overnight. A follow-through selloff in mega-cap tech drags the whole index.
Oil & the 10-year — WTI ~$103 and Brent >$107 feed inflation fear with the 10Y already near a multi-year high (~4.96%). A rate pop compounds pressure on stocks and hardens the hike case.

Thin single-name liquidity — the one boarded name (ZIM) is flagged OI-thin (191) and one-sided; its scanner price ($29.71) is also stale vs the ~$30.37 pre-market. Confirm a real ATM market before ever attempting a fill.
